notes.title: Welcome to the new realm!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30753361/fbd9755862367e54eb3c0b70371a6b0e67cffaa6.jpg[/img]

The world we know is torn apart by war. Invaders and plunderers scourge the lands, ravaging cities and villages alike, torturing the innocent.
Who will be the one to bring justice when the time is direst? Only a true hero can walk the path to glory and become the ultimate Dragon Master. We call upon you champion! It is time for you to claim what is yours and redeem the dying world!

Dragon Glory, the brand new MMORPG where you can fulfill your destiny and reach the skies. Start your adventures as a mighty warrior or wise sorcerer, assemble a real dream team and crush your enemies in dynamic turn-based combat. Forge alliances and fight for glory alongside your friends. Vanquish your foes in epic PvP battles across all realms and unite them to defeat epic bosses scattered throughout the world.

Welcome to the new realm!
